method: DAO read-only sealed copy; blank host imports object definitions; source database never opened in Access UI

properties.Name: m_class
properties.ValidationRule: [school_year]>=1900 And [school_year]<=9998 And ([capacity] Is Null Or ([capacity]>=1 And [capacity]<=9999)) And [display_order]>=0 And [grade_category]="GRADE" And [valid_from]<=[valid_to] And [valid_from]>=CStr([school_year]) & "-04-01" And [valid_to]<=CStr([school_year]+1) & "-03-31"

properties.Name: m_code
properties.ValidationRule: [display_order]>=0 And ([valid_to] Is Null Or [valid_from]<=[valid_to]) And [code_value] Not Like "*[!0-9]*"

properties.Name: m_student
properties.ValidationRule: [gender_category]="GENDER" And [prefecture_category]="PREFECTURE" And [enrollment_category]="ENROLLMENT_STATUS" And [birth_date]>="1900-01-01" And [birth_date]<=[admission_date] And (([enrollment_status_code] In ("01","02") And [class_id] Is Not Null And [enrollment_end_date] Is Null) Or ([enrollment_status_code] In ("03","04") And [enrollment_end_date] Is Not Null And [admission_date]<=[enrollment_end_date])) And ([phone_number] Is Not Null Or [email_address] Is Not Null Or [emergency_phone_number] Is Not Null) And (([emergency_contact_name] Is Null And [relationship_category] Is Null And [relationship_code] Is Null And [emergency_phone_number] Is Null) Or ([emergency_contact_name] Is Not Null And [relationship_category] Is Not Null And [relationship_category]="RELATIONSHIP" And [relationship_code] Is Not Null And [emergency_phone_number] Is Not Null)) And (([is_deleted]=False And [deleted_at] Is Null And [deleted_by] Is Null And [delete_reason] Is Null) Or ([is_deleted]=True And [deleted_at] Is Not Null And [deleted_by] Is Not Null And [delete_reason] Is Not Null))

properties.Name: t_operation_log
properties.ValidationRule: [after_version]>0 And ([before_version] Is Null Or [before_version]>0) And [operation_type] In ("CREATE","UPDATE","DELETE","DISABLE","ENABLE")

queries.name: ~sq_cfrmStudentEdit~sq_ccboGrade
queries.sql:
SELECT code_value, code_name
FROM m_code
WHERE category_id='GRADE'
ORDER BY display_order, code_value;
